name: Inscribed Bark
summary: In Teldrassil, Inscribed Bark carries word of the World Tree's state to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm. The Oracle Tree entrusts it with news of the boughs and the threats troubling the woods.

sections.title: A Message from the Oracle
sections.body: The Oracle Tree sends Inscribed Bark to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus. After you drive the harpies from their nests, the ancient tree gives you its message, wary of sending ordinary couriers along Teldrassil's tainted paths. The report tells Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm of recent victories and the deeper blight still gripping the woods.

faq.answer: Inscribed Bark carries a report from the Oracle Tree to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus, telling of the boughs' health and dangers.

faq.q: Who sends this message and why?
faq.answer: The Oracle Tree gives Inscribed Bark to you after you drive harpies from their nests. Wary of sending ordinary messengers across the endangered forest paths, it entrusts the report to a proven traveler.

faq.q: How does Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm react to the message?
aliases: what does fandral say about bark
faq.answer: Fandral acknowledges the respite gained from clearing the harpies, but says deeper problems persist. The report renews his anxiety over whether his work on Teldrassil can restore the night elves' lost immortality.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you know messages carried on ancient bark bind nature to its guardians, linking wild groves with Darnassus's marble terraces.
As a druid, you recognize Inscribed Bark as an urgent message from an ancient ally, speaking of the delicate balance and afflictions troubling the young World Tree.
